format: PR-53 (tasks.md T053) decision ledger for every web/shared disagreement that PR-02 froze in web-presentation-vectors.json. The vectors file is a hash-pinned oracle and keeps the smart-add-web/1 outcomes of the web helpers as they were measured; this file records what PR-53 did about each one. resolved: smartAdd.ts was corrected and now returns the shared value (the divergence's fields for a parse case, the server verdict for a probe). accepted: the web outcome stays and the reason names why the Rust-backed server remains the final authority anyway. Every parse case with a divergence and every probe with agrees=false appears exactly once; the web suite (smartAddVectors.test.ts) and the Rust suite (bb-domain tests/web_presentation.rs) both fail on a missing, extra or mis-decided row. Versioning here is test/build evidence only: it is not an authorization token and adds no client API (command-catalog.md, web transition).

parse.reason: JavaScript lower-casing keeps U+00DF where the server's casefold gives 'ss', so the optimistic chip shows a new tag 'ß'. The web submits {name} and the server resolves it onto the stored 'ss', so the stored result is identical.
The composer counted UTF-16 units against the 500 limit and refused a 300-emoji title the server accepts. Lengths are now counted in Unicode scalars, as the server, Swift and Rust do.

The removal mask was built over UTF-16 indexes but applied to code points, so after one astral character the composer left the sigil in and deleted the wrong characters and would have submitted a corrupted title. The mask is now applied per UTF-16 unit.
Same defect as WP-P-052 with two astral characters; the title is now 'text today' without the corrupted '@hoday'.

name_collision_probes.reason: Case folding of U+00DF to 'ss' is not available to JavaScript lower-casing. The typed tag is submitted by name and the server resolves it onto the stored tag, so no duplicate is stored.
Case folding of U+1C80 to U+0432 is not available to JavaScript lower-casing. The typed tag is submitted by name and the server resolves it onto the stored tag, so no duplicate is stored.
U+001C..U+001F are whitespace to the server but not to JavaScript \s. The web now strips and collapses exactly the server whitespace set.
U+FEFF is JavaScript \s but not server whitespace; the web used to bind a typed tag to a stored one the server keeps apart. The web now uses the server whitespace set.
U+0085 is whitespace to the server but not to JavaScript \s. The web now strips and collapses exactly the server whitespace set.
